title: This is a great soap dish!
text: This is a great soap dish!. I love it.  It's very easy to install and put together.  It sticks very well to the shower wall.  It doesn't stick by suction cups, but by a strong adhesive.  I did break one of the plastic clamps by putting too much pressure on it, but it came with a backup which is great!  I love that soap doesn't puddle in it because of the wire holder, which is sturdy.
